data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's prior year development is mixed. The 2019 underwriting year closed with a declared profit of $15.1m, indicating a release of reserves for that year, despite being impacted by natural catastrophes including Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai. Conversely, the 2020 underwriting year is currently forecasting a loss, primarily due to the COVID-19 pandemic and a higher than average volume of natural catastrophe events, including Hurricanes Laura, Sally, Delta, and Zeta. The 2021 underwriting year was also impacted by losses from Hurricane Ida, Storm Uri, European flood damage, and an increased volume of ransomware attacks.
